verification_scope: Frozen code/config identity, checkpoint hashes, complete 218 IDs and per-image means verified by load_completed. Independently recomputed nine scores/counts on 12 saved third-seed best/final arrays; all differences 0. Earlier reviews cover first/second seed raw checks. Not a fresh full-218 inference.
plot_review: All three LoRA curves descend quickly and reach early minima at 200/500/300 attempts; training loss continues down after the validation minimum. The third seed rebounds and only returns close to its own best in the last two evaluations.

Third-seed final AbsRel is only 0.1094% above best, but steps 700-1100 fail the 1% band and only 1200-1300 qualify. A 100-step terminal suffix is shorter than required 500, so stable_step correctly remains null. All three L400 runs fail this predefined stability rule.
All three confirm the <=0.10 target at step 300; none has three successive <=0.09 evaluations, even though seed 320113 reaches a best below 0.09. No invented zero or missing-target interpolation.
Best accuracy improves from L200 to L400 in all seeds, while best F1 and boundary-band accuracy worsen in all seeds. This is a tradeoff, not uniform sample benefit.

The L200 endpoint F1 dip is driven strongly by seed 320112. L400 final F1 is higher on average, but matched differences have signs positive/negative/positive. The chart must not be interpreted as all-seed edge recovery.
R400 shows slower improvement with two of three stable runs; L400 has lower validation-selected error and fewer updates but zero stable runs. These are distinct operational observations.
At this snapshot, J400 and S400 have no completed runs and are explicitly blank. J400 training is active; the graph is not evidence for a joint-model result.
conclusions: Complete-group L400 best AbsRel 0.0905177 +/- 0.0013443; RMSE 0.4116191 +/- 0.0055770 m; delta1 0.9277067 +/- 0.0033700; boundary F1 0.4661753 +/- 0.0041870; boundary-band AbsRel 0.1534662 +/- 0.0023713. SD is across three training seeds.

L400 versus matched L200: best AbsRel difference -0.00298240 (about 3.19% reduction), scene CI [-0.00581364,-0.00024126]; delta1 +0.00873956 with CI [0.00103449,0.01658219]. All three improve these metrics. RMSE interval includes zero.

L400 versus L200 best F1 difference -0.00426252 and boundary-band error +0.00184554; all three seed means worsen, but both conditional scene intervals include zero. There is no evidence of a boundary improvement from adding these 200 images.

L400 versus R400 best: mean AbsRel -0.00490293, all three seeds improve, but scene CI [-0.01088930,0.00064228] includes zero. The earlier two-seed interval excluding zero is superseded; do not retain the stronger interim claim. RMSE, delta1 and boundary-band intervals also include zero.

L400 versus R400 best F1 improves by 0.01563394, CI [0.00944383,0.02241263], with all seeds improving. This edge gain is supported under the scene-resampling diagnostic, while the global-error comparison remains less certain.

Compared with original B0, all five best metrics improve in all seeds and conditional scene intervals exclude zero: AbsRel -0.03032785, RMSE -0.06406814 m, delta1 +0.06289110, F1 +0.01502051, boundary-band AbsRel -0.02958088. Existing first-seed difficult cases are still retained.

Final versus best AbsRel changes +2.68%, +2.27%, +0.1094%; F1 changes +0.006518, -0.009153, -0.001637. Mean F1 change interval includes zero. Boundary-band error improves in all seeds, average -0.00341167 with interval below zero; delta1 worsens with interval below zero. These are descriptive selected-best versus terminal comparisons, not a new checkpoint selection rule.

Average best step is 333.33 and average stop step 1333.33. Stable runs 0/3. Recorded total elapsed 852.89 +/- 97.48 s includes training, validation and detailed scoring, excluding shared setup; process attempt time is separately retained. No isolated hardware benchmark.

LoRA has 73728 trainable parameters and peak allocated memory 4019.69 MiB, versus R 27089 and 768.71 MiB. AMP skips 0/1/1 are recorded and unsuccessful updates excluded from successful-update totals; no batch/configuration changes.

The 200-to-400 contrast is interim in the execution order. Planned 300-image runs will later fill adjacent sample-count comparisons. Continue all 72 stages unchanged, then the frozen test evaluation; no new model selection, architecture search or 795-image refit.
statistics_limits: Three-seed SD and conditional scene-bootstrap intervals answer different uncertainties. Bootstrap: 62 scene clusters, 2000 replicates, seed 320119, retaining image weights; no multiple-comparison adjustment and no population guarantee from three seeds. Validation has been used for early stopping. Test has historical exposure and no new test runs have been performed.
